crossRefs.note: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of…
So that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.
They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.
“If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,
He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
In you have they treated father and mother with contempt. Among you they have oppressed the foreigner. In you they have…
They trample on the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and deny justice to the oppressed; and a man and his…
Listen to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy…
Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,
I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers…
Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go…

translations.web: You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the foreigners who are in your land within your gates.
translations.bsb: Do not oppress a hired hand who is poor and needy, whether he is a brother or a foreigner residing in one of your towns.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not oppress an hired servant that is poor and needy, whether he be of thy brethren, or of thy strangers that are in thy land within thy gates:
translations.asv: Thou shalt not oppress a hired servant that is poor and needy, whether he be of thy brethren, or of thy sojourners that are in thy land within thy gates:
